text: {"memo": "Adobe Inc. (ADBE) concluded its fiscal year 2024 (ended December 2024) with revenue of $19.8 billion, up from $17.8 billion in fiscal 2023 and $15.9 billion in fiscal 2022, reflecting sustained growth driven by strong adoption of its Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, and Experience Cloud offerings. The company reported non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $14.50 for fiscal 2024, up from $13.05 in 2023 and $11.07 in 2022, demonstrating consistent profitability despite ongoing investments in artificial intelligence and generative AI features across its product suite. Net income for the year was approximately $6.1 billion, with operating margins holding steady at around 32%, supported by the high-margin subscription model. Adobe generated $8.2 billion in operating cash flow during fiscal 2024, up from $7.4 billion in the prior year, underscoring the strength and predictability of its recurring revenue base. The company ended fiscal 2024 with approximately $4.5 billion in cash and marketable securities, after significant share repurchases and continued R&D spending. Growth in the Experience Cloud segment remained solid, particularly in analytics and personalization, though it faced competitive pressures from larger cloud vendors. Adobe’s integration of generative AI tools—such as Firefly and Sensei—into its core products has helped maintain user engagement and drive cross-selling. Looking ahead, the company is focused on AI-driven workflow automation and expanding its enterprise footprint. Adobe stock remains a high-conviction holding for long-term investors seeking innovation and durable cash flows."}
